proposed_changes.v1_0_state: UNSPECIFIED -- covariance.type was 'cluster_robust' with cluster_variable 'ticker', but no variant was named
proposed_changes.proposed_description: Bias-reduced linearization (Bell & McCaffrey 2002). Cluster-robust sandwich in which the residual block u_g is replaced by A_g u_g, with A_g = (I - H_gg)^(-1/2) and H_gg = X_g (X'X)^(-1) X_g'.
proposed_changes.rationale_source: Bell & McCaffrey (2002); Cameron & Miller (2015) Table 2; Pustejovsky & Tipton (2018)
proposed_changes.alternative_the_reviewer_may_prefer: CV3 (cluster jackknife) with t(G-1). Published performance is comparable and the degrees-of-freedom rule is simpler and more reproducible. See review packet Q2.

proposed_changes.v1_0_state: finite_sample_correction: true -- a boolean with no procedure attached

proposed_value.computed_from: the realized design matrix, under the working model Omega = I
proposed_value.definition: nu = (sum_i lambda_i)^2 / (sum_i lambda_i^2), where lambda_i are the eigenvalues of G'G and the g-th column of G is (I - H)_[.,g] A_g X_g (X'X)^(-1) c, with c = (0,1)'

proposed_changes.rationale_source: Bell & McCaffrey (2002); Imbens & Kolesar (2016); Cameron & Miller (2015)
proposed_changes.note: nu depends on the realized design and cannot be computed in advance. Only the RULE is fixable in advance.

proposed_changes.v1_0_state: coefficient, 95% CI, p-value, eligible-event count, unique-ticker count
proposed_addition: realized effective number of clusters (G*, Carter-Schnepel-Steigerwald)
the CV1 standard error, reported as a comparability reference and NOT as the inferential rule
proposed_changes.rationale: A very small nu is itself a finding about evidential strength and must not be hidden. Reporting CV1 alongside makes the small-cluster correction visible rather than buried.

proposed_value.justification: Exactly one primary confirmatory hypothesis, one predictor, one outcome, one test, all fixed before any data exists.
proposed_value.secondary_and_exploratory: HYP-02 and HYP-03, and all registered secondary/exploratory analyses, are reported with a predeclared non-confirmatory treatment. They carry no confirmatory claim, cannot change the HYP-01 conclusion, and are not pooled with it into a single tested family.
proposed_value.promotion_rule_unchanged: Promotion to confirmatory may never be based on observed results.

proposed_changes.reviewer_question: If an adjustment IS required, which, and over what family? See review packet Q6.

proposed_changes.applies_to: the SECONDARY adjusted sensitivity model only -- which cannot overturn or rescue the primary result

proposed_value.sector_source: Live Signal Engine/GST_Sector_ETF_Mapping_v0.1.json (unchanged by this proposal)
proposed_value.rationale: No reference sector is scientifically privileged among the locked 24 tickers. Sum coding makes the intercept the unweighted grand mean and each sector term a deviation from it.
proposed_value.effect_on_beta_gst: NONE -- treatment and sum coding span the same column space; the gst_zscore estimate and standard error are identical under either.
proposed_value.sparse_sector_rule: PLACEHOLDER_PENDING_METHODOLOGIST -- a predeclared rule for sectors contributing too few eligible events must be fixed before the first observation. No rule is invented here.

proposed_value.restricted_or_unrestricted: PLACEHOLDER_PENDING_METHODOLOGIST -- WCR (restricted, null imposed) is the literature default
proposed_value.seed_policy: A fixed seed must be recorded at the event-60 freeze; a stochastic procedure without a recorded seed is not reproducible.
proposed_value.rationale: MacKinnon, Nielsen & Webb (2022) recommend WCR bootstrap routinely as corroboration. Cameron & Miller (2015) Table 2 shows it did not dominate CV2 + Satterthwaite at small G. Allowing a second procedure to overturn the first would be method-shopping.

proposed_changes.v1_0_state: v1.0 placed cluster_covariance_option_string and finite_sample_correction_option in environment_freeze as TO_BE_FROZEN_AT_EVENT_60, bundled with package and version. This means the estimator choice would be made implicitly by whoever typed the option string at event 60.

fixed_before_first_prospective_observati: alpha and sidedness (already locked in v1.0)
wild-bootstrap role, variant, replications and weight distribution (D-sensitivity)
sector coding for the secondary model (C9)
recorded_at_event_60_freeze: the literal option string implementing the already-fixed estimator
proposed_value.principle: A rule is chosen by a human on scientific grounds. A record is transcribed from the environment. Recording a value is not deciding one.

unresolved_questions_for_methodologist.question: Is there a minimum effective degrees of freedom, or minimum effective number of clusters G*, below which this design should not support a confirmatory conclusion?
unresolved_questions_for_methodologist.explicitly_not_proposed: This proposal deliberately invents NO threshold. Supplying a number here would be exactly the failure the preregistration gap audit exists to prevent: a value that looks locked because it appears in a file, chosen by an author with no standing to choose it.
consequence_options_if_threshold_breache: report as inconclusive with the interval published
unresolved_questions_for_methodologist.hard_constraint: Whatever the rule, it must be fixed before the first prospective observation and must NEVER be evaluated after seeing the coefficient.

unresolved_questions_for_methodologist.question: Should CV3 with t(G-1) be preferred over CV2 with Satterthwaite, on grounds of comparable published performance and a simpler, more reproducible degrees-of-freedom rule?
Should a pre-data design-sensitivity or power analysis be performed, and on what externally justified effect sizes?
constraints: must occur before any prospective outcome exists
must use externally justified or clearly hypothetical effect sizes
must NEVER use observed project results, including the retrospective reconstruction
must NOT silently revise the locked n = 60

unresolved_questions_for_methodologist.question: Does the expected 60-events-over-at-most-24-tickers structure warrant a per-ticker cap on eligible events?
unresolved_questions_for_methodologist.warning: Any such cap changes the SAMPLE DEFINITION, which is a currently locked element, and would require a separate amendment beyond this one.

unresolved_questions_for_methodologist.question: What is the predeclared rule for sectors contributing too few eligible events in the secondary adjusted model?

CV2 with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom is NOT available in statsmodels 0.14.6, the regression library in this project's environment. Should the project add an R/clubSandwich dependency, or implement and validate CV2 in Python against a published reference?
unresolved_questions_for_methodologist.note: Either path is work that must complete BEFORE the first prospective observation, not at the freeze.
